card.name: Dose unit right after a number
card.fires_on: The last digit of a dose number or the unit (mcg, mg, MBq) written right after it. It appears in dose amounts such as 0.625 mg, 40 mg, 44 mcg.

modes.label: Digit inside dose
modes.description: The final digit of a decimal dose number just before the unit.

modes.label: Unit after number
modes.description: The unit mg or part of a unit like mcg or MBq directly after a dose number.
modes.example: is 40<< mg>> administered every other week.

card.plain: It marks the spot where a dose amount and its unit are being written out.
